query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND attributes.condition == "Ready" AND `metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` == 1 AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS ready = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp) BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.node_name
| STATS not_ready = COUNT(CASE(ready != "True", 1, NULL)) BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.cluster_name
| EVAL health = CASE(not_ready == 0, "Healthy", "Unhealthy")
| STATS clusters = COUNT(*) BY health

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND attributes.condition == "Ready" AND `metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` == 1 AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS ready = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp) BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.node_name
| STATS not_ready = COUNT(CASE(ready != "True", 1, NULL)) BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.cluster_name
| EVAL health = CASE(not_ready == 0, "Healthy", "Unhealthy")
| STATS clusters = COUNT(*) BY health

embeddableConfig.description: Share of clusters that are healthy (every node's latest `Ready` condition is True) or unhealthy (at least one node is not ready) in the time range. An Unhealthy slice means some workloads may be running with less capacity than planned.
embeddableConfig.title: Clusters by health

query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS used = MAX(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/core_usage_time`)), alloc = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_cores`))
    BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS used = SUM(used), alloc = SUM(alloc) BY cluster, bucket
| EVAL cpu_utilization = CASE(alloc > 0, used / alloc, NULL)
| SORT bucket ASC, cpu_utilization DESC, cluster ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY bucket

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS used = MAX(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/core_usage_time`)), alloc = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_cores`))
    BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS used = SUM(used), alloc = SUM(alloc) BY cluster, bucket
| EVAL cpu_utilization = CASE(alloc > 0, used / alloc, NULL)
| SORT bucket ASC, cpu_utilization DESC, cluster ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY bucket

embeddableConfig.description: The 10 clusters using the largest share of their CPU in each time bucket: CPU used by the cluster's nodes (`node/cpu/core_usage_time` rate) divided by their allocatable cores. Sustained values near 100% leave no room for new pods and slow down running workloads.
embeddableConfig.title: Top 10 clusters by CPU utilization

query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`)), alloc = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_bytes`))
    BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, node = resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL pods_used = util * alloc
| STATS memory_utilization = CASE(SUM(alloc) > 0, SUM(pods_used) / SUM(alloc), NULL) BY cluster, bucket
| SORT bucket ASC, memory_utilization DESC, cluster ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY bucket

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";

| STATS util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`)), alloc = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_bytes`))
    BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, node = resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL pods_used = util * alloc
| STATS memory_utilization = CASE(SUM(alloc) > 0, SUM(pods_used) / SUM(alloc), NULL) BY cluster, bucket
| SORT bucket ASC, memory_utilization DESC, cluster ASC

embeddableConfig.description: The 10 clusters using the largest share of their memory in each time bucket: non-evictable memory used by pods on the cluster's nodes divided by their allocatable memory (`node/memory/allocatable_utilization`). Sustained values near 100% lead to pod evictions and out-of-memory kills.
embeddableConfig.title: Top 10 clusters by memory utilization

query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND (attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL OR attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL OR attributes.daemonset IS NOT NULL) AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS d_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_spec_replicas/gauge`)), d_avail = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/gauge`)), s_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_replicas/gauge`)), s_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready/gauge`)), ds_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled/gauge`)), ds_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_ready/gauge`)), ds_missched = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_misscheduled/gauge`)) BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster, namespace = resource.attributes.namespace, name = COALESCE(attributes.deployment, attributes.statefulset, attributes.daemonset) | EVAL shortfall = CASE(d_desired IS NOT NULL, d_desired - d_avail, s_desired IS NOT NULL, s_desired - s_ready, ds_desired - ds_ready) | WHERE shortfall > 0 OR ds_missched > 0 | STATS workloads_short = COUNT(*)

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND (attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL OR attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL OR attributes.daemonset IS NOT NULL) AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS d_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_spec_replicas/gauge`)), d_avail = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/gauge`)), s_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_replicas/gauge`)), s_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready/gauge`)), ds_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled/gauge`)), ds_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_ready/gauge`)), ds_missched = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_misscheduled/gauge`)) BY cluster = resource.attributes.cluster, namespace = resource.attributes.namespace, name = COALESCE(attributes.deployment, attributes.statefulset, attributes.daemonset) | EVAL shortfall = CASE(d_desired IS NOT NULL, d_desired - d_avail, s_desired IS NOT NULL, s_desired - s_ready, ds_desired - ds_ready) | WHERE shortfall > 0 OR ds_missched > 0 | STATS workloads_short = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets with fewer available or ready replicas than desired, or with misscheduled DaemonSet pods, using the latest values in the time range (kube-state-metrics). Should be 0; anything higher means a workload runs with less capacity than planned. Empty without kube-state-metrics.
embeddableConfig.title: Short of desired
